notes.title: Update notes 4th March and some words of gratitude
notes.notes:
[h3]Hello friends! [/h3]

First of all: Thank you so much for playing [b]Bubumbu[/b], and by doing so making this launch special! And special thanks to those of you who left reviews - it means a lot! This may be a small game, but we did put a lot of effort into creating a unique experience, not least our creative director and artist Vania, who made all the amazing and cute artwork which gives [b]Bubumbu[/b] it's charm. 

Now over to... [u]THE UPDATE[/u]:

Even though we searched [i]thoroughly[/i] for bugs the week before release, there seem to have been one that slipped past us (thanks to the user that made us aware of this). So here are the changes for this new version:

[h2]Bug fix:[/h2]
-  The quest log in [i]Fairytale Trail[/i] now shows the correct number of findable mushrooms.

[h2]Small edits:[/h2]
- Made one of the mushrooms in Fairytale Trail a little easier to find (it was barley visible, but cred to those who found it anyway!)
- The space in front of the monarch on the hill in Fairytale Trail is no longer an invisible wall for no good reason. 
- Added one candle to be found on the [i]Sunny Coast[/i]. 7 candles feels better. So now all of you have a reason to revisit the beach :)

[h2]In other news:[/h2] 
We are looking into making a Mac version, we just need to solve some technical problems first. We also have a draft for a bonus level, but need to rest a little before we get to it.

Best wishes,
[b]An Otter Team[/b] ʢ·͡ᴥ·ʡ
